root_cause.text: The driver freed `tsdata->raw_buffer` in `edt_ft5x06_ts_teardown_debugfs()` without holding the device mutex or clearing the pointer, leaving a race window where a concurrent debugfs read could access the freed buffer (use-after-free).
root_cause.evidence: The patch adds `guard(mutex)(&tsdata->mutex)` before `kfree(tsdata->raw_buffer)` and sets `tsdata->raw_buffer = NULL` after freeing. The commit message confirms that debugfs files remain accessible during teardown and the read function already checks `raw_buffer` under the same mutex, so the fix ensures proper synchronization.

intent_record.what: Added a mutex guard (guard(mutex)(&tsdata->mutex)) before kfree(tsdata->raw_buffer) and set tsdata->raw_buffer to NULL after freeing in edt_ft5x06_ts_teardown_debugfs function.
intent_record.how: The change acquires the tsdata mutex just before freeing raw_buffer, ensuring exclusive access; after freeing, the pointer is set to NULL to avoid dangling references. The mutex is automatically released when the guard goes out of scope at the end of the function.
